annotations.title: Scholarly Citation Compiler (BibTeX, APA, IEEE, MLA) & DOI Resolver

description: Formats academic paper metadata and DOI identifiers into standard scholarly citation formats (BibTeX, APA, IEEE, MLA). Use when generating bibliographies for research papers, validating journal references, or resolving DOI identifiers; for structuring research timelines, use summarize_temporal_timeline instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'source_content_or_doi' ('citation_style' defaults to 'bibtex_format'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

citation_style.description: Bibliographic citation standard: BibTeX format, APA 7th edition, IEEE standard, or MLA 9th edition.

include_abstract.description: Whether to include publication abstract in structured metadata.

source_content_or_doi.description: DOI string, arXiv ID, or raw paper title with author list to format into citation.

name: extract_scholarly_citations

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for extract_scholarly_citations.

citation_style.description: Citation specification name applied to the formatted reference.

formatted_citation.description: Formatted bibliographic reference string adhering to the chosen citation standard.

metadata.description: Parsed bibliographic fields including title, authors, year, journal, and doi.
